item.title: Bank of Canada maintains the policy rate at 2¼%

rating.summary: The Bank of Canada held its overnight rate at 2.25%, citing a broadening economic recovery in Canada with Q2 GDP growth of 3.3% and improving labour markets. CPI inflation remains around 3%, driven largely by persistently high gasoline prices, while core inflation stays near 2%. The statement highlights increased upside risks to inflation from elevated oil prices and new US tariffs, alongside uncertainty around growth prospects.
rating.stance_rationale: The hold decision with an explicit acknowledgment of increased upside inflation risks and a preparedness to adjust policy as needed leans slightly hawkish relative to neutral, though the balanced assessment of growth uncertainty prevents a stronger hawkish signal.
key_quotes: the upside risks to inflation have increased, while new tariffs make growth prospects more uncertain
The longer that high oil prices and elevated refinery margins persist, the greater the risk of spillover to the prices of other goods and services.
